summary: Frontend-only mandatory retest executed on public preview. Core menu/hash routing regression is resolved for pointer and keyboard flows, but gallery and victory filter controls remain non-interactable due to being rendered outside viewport under transformed spatial canvas state.

ui_bugs.issue: gallery-next-button is outside viewport when routed to victories context (bounding y around -2487), so click fails and gallery strip does not move.
Year chip buttons intermittently outside viewport in same transformed state; click action fails with out-of-viewport error.
Next quote button click did not change featured quote in diagnostic run (content remained same).

integration_issues.issue: Unified spatial transform/camera state can leave target controls detached from viewport hit area, blocking pointer actions despite visible sections.

action_items: Fix transformed/camera coordinate state so gallery controls stay in viewport and clickable after route-victories navigation.
Fix victory year filter chip hit targets under unified spatial routing state.
Validate quote next control updates content deterministically in the same state.
After fixes, rerun mandatory set with emphasis on Gallery/quote/victory block.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav pointer matrix path appears stabilized; hash and HUD labels now match across fresh, sequential, quick-click, Enter, and Space flows.
Issue scope shifted from menu routing to deep-section interaction geometry: controls become non-actionable due to off-viewport layout coordinates while still logically present.
Single-line compressed component structure (Nav/SpatialExperience/StorySections) continues to reduce debuggability for spatial transform and interaction-boundary regressions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run-1 passed all menu/hash/timeline/home/error-overflow checks; gallery click failed out-of-viewport and blocked quote/victory assertions in that script. Targeted run and diagnostic run reproduced out-of-viewport failures for gallery and year-filter controls. Diagnostic captured gallery-next bounding box with negative y, confirming viewport detachment under spatial transform state.
rca of the issue: Repro: load preview -> navigate to #route-victories (or via menu) -> attempt gallery-next / victory year chip click. Observed: Playwright reports element outside viewport; gallery button rect y is strongly negative despite section visibility. Likely RCA: transformed unified spatial canvas/route camera creates mismatch between visual position and actual hit-test coordinates for deep-section controls. Mitigation: normalize transform/hit-area for interactive descendants (or place controls in non-transformed overlay layer), then retest quote/gallery/victory interactions.
